name: Finite Element Method (FEM)
summary: Approximate PDE weak formulations in finite-dimensional function spaces over a mesh.
summary_zh: 利用弱形式、试探函数与测试函数构造离散方程。
core_idea: Construct weak form integrals and approximate solution functions with local basis functions.
innovation: Supports geometric flexibility and weak-form treatment of many PDE systems.
limitations: Solution spaces and stabilization must match the PDE.
Numerical integration and meshing can dominate modeling quality.

start_here.why: Strong reference for the mathematical mechanism and finite element error analysis.
start_here.focus: Weak formulations, finite-element spaces, interpolation and approximation.
